name: smoke
purpose: Verify that the workloads build, the runner sweeps, results serialize, the analysis reads them back and the figures draw. Not evidence about anything.
not_evidence: distilgpt2 cannot do the multistep task at all, so every multistep metric here is expected to be zero and the full-cache solvability check is expected to flag every multistep cell. That is the check working, not a result.
expected_skips: multistep at prompt 128 is feasible at low redundancy only: medium needs 165 prompt tokens and high needs 265 before any filler, so those cells are refused rather than run at the wrong prompt length.
seed_semantics: task_seeds choose the task instance; eviction_seeds choose the random baseline's draw and nothing else. They are swept independently so a random method's spread can be attributed to one or the other, and deterministic methods are decoded once per task instance rather than once per draw.
